stance_rationale: Phase A design documents are coherent but the package is not auditable as an alpha output: alpha_vector is empty, alpha_scores.parquet is missing, IC/Harvey/DSR/sub-stability are unrealized, and AX-008 remains 0/3. Treat this as a design draft only; it cannot pass alpha admission without Forge artifacts and PIT-verifiable feature lineage.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260519_002/alpha_scores.parquet is missing and alpha_vector is a placeholder; Date x Ticker x score multi-sig-date schema cannot be verified.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No factor_engine_proposal.R or emitted feature panel exists; custom rolling z-scores are specified but Z_Score_Aligned-only compliance and absence of manual sign flips are not implementation-verifiable.
No Usable_Date-bearing feature panel or alpha_scores artifact exists, so Usable_Date <= sig_date cannot be audited.
The package says Factor DB should use load_month_factors(), but no implementation artifact proves parquet direct-load avoidance.
Lag rules are declared, but no implemented dd/vol/regime lag vector exists; monthly label and sig_date alignment remain ambiguous.
No direct accounting fundamental feature is in the proposed F01-F32 catalog; C4 must be rechecked if DART/fundamental inputs are added.

critical_concerns.description: Required empirical artifacts are absent: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, final alpha_package.json, challenge_note, and other-agent packages are missing. RF-A7 cannot be cleared and AX-002 says only harness-produced performance is valid.

Monthly target alignment is fragile: the protocol defines bad_month_t from same-month KOSPI return while features are computed at month-end using t-1 data. Unless the signal explicitly predicts t+1 forward return, this is same-period aggregation/application leakage.

IC diagnostics are replaced by design-stage proxy metrics, but no realized AUC/Brier/Recall/Precision, Harvey t, DSR, rank_IC, ICIR, or sub-stability exists. RF-A1, RF-A2, RF-A3, and RF-A6 therefore remain unresolved.

The method-shopping surface is undercounted: 32 features, 5 model classes, 3 ensemble strategies, multiple frequency modes, label thresholds, and aggregation methods are declared as candidates_tried=1. That is not enough to defuse multiple-testing inflation.

The max-history claim relies on 1990-2000 S1 data where only 3 universal features are active. Stratum_id plus NaN handling may let models learn era membership rather than bear mechanisms, so 4/5 sub-window stability is not yet credible.

The package declares FRED/ECOS/KRX publish lags, but there is no feature-level publish_date or Usable_Date table. FRED reference-date confusion and ECOS release-delay variation remain unresolved PIT risks.

Path B standalone regime overlay can affect portfolio risk and turnover, but cost, turnover, MDD, and downstream NAV DSR are deferred. Charter cost/capacity and hard-constraint compliance are therefore not yet testable.

supporting_arguments: The draft explicitly documents source coverage, lag rules, S1 feature asymmetry, VKOSPI dependency, and no-backfill intent instead of hiding these issues.
The design correctly treats the current output as Phase A and defers empirical admission to Forge, Architect, and later Codex review.
No substantive use of the base auto-flag phrases was found as justification; the exact phrases appear mainly inside self-check/veto detection lists.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a market-level p_bad series satisfies the alpha_scores.parquet Date x Ticker x score contract or requires a separate schema waiver.
Whether daily max aggregation can be used at a monthly rebalance without using intra-month future information.
Whether candidates_tried=1 is defensible once feature subsets, thresholds, frequency modes, model families, calibration methods, and ensemble strategies are evaluated.
Whether S1 full-history inclusion improves real OOS stability or injects structural-break noise.
Whether AX-008 can pass when current status is 0/3 pending and no Forge or Architect execution exists.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that max-history expansion plus academic feature design and a 5-model ensemble will repair v5's recall/sub-window failure despite severe stratum feature asymmetry and no realized PIT time-series artifact.
rebuttal_required: Emit alpha_scores.parquet or p_bad_monthly.parquet with sig_date, forecast_target_date, score, and Usable_Date lineage; show n_sig_dates and date range.
Provide feature_panel_bear_v1.parquet plus per-feature lookahead_detector.R and pit_enforcement.R results.
Report realized G1 metrics by sub-window and crisis: AUC, Brier, Recall, Precision, false-positive rate.
Report Harvey/Newey-West t, DSR or justified regime-sensor replacement, and Diebold-Mariano test against persistence/random baselines.
Recompute method_shopping_log counting all evaluated feature subsets, model families, thresholds, frequency modes, aggregation methods, and ensemble strategies.
Clarify monthly label timing: prove the signal at sig_date predicts only forward t+1 or next-20d returns.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: AX-008 is not merely pending; for this critique it fails because Forge empirical execution, Architect re-execution, and final package artifacts are absent.

alpha vector 시계열에 future leakage 없는가? 특히 monthly bad label과 sig_date alignment가 forward target인가?
AX-axiom EXCLUSION에 의존하는 가설이라면 EXCLUSION 충족이 necessary AND sufficient한가?
32 features x 5 models x 3 ensemble strategies를 candidates_tried=1로 보는 근거가 RF-A6를 통과할 만큼 강한가?
S1 1990-2000의 3-feature regime이 2020s S4 full-feature regime과 같은 모델로 묶일 수 있는가?
